extraFacts.fact: A constant flow control valve holds a set flow rate in a liquid line while the pressure across it changes; a self-closing valve closes by itself when the handle is released.

faqs.q: What are Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves used for?
faqs.a: Plast-O-Matic FC series valves are PVC flow control valves that hold a set flow rate in a liquid line as the pressure changes. This listing has 5 part numbers in 1/2, 3/4 and 1 inch with NPT threaded connections and EPDM seals; see the [industrial process valves shelf](/c/industrial-process-valves).

faqs.q: How do I read the Plast-O-Matic FC200EP and FC300EP part numbers?
faqs.a: In the rows, FC200EP and FC300EP are valve bodies, the three digits after the dash give the size (050 is 1/2 inch, 075 is 3/4 inch, 100 is 1 inch) and -PV is PVC. FC200EP-050-PV, FC200EP-075-PV and FC200EP-100-PV are the FC200EP valves.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the small-size Plast-O-Matic FC listing cover?
faqs.a: 1/2 inch (FC200EP-050-PV), 3/4 inch (FC200EP-075-PV and FC300EP-075-PV) and 1 inch (FC200EP-100-PV and FC300EP-100-PV). Larger sizes are on the [2 inch](/p/plast-o-matic-fc-series-constant-flow-control-valves-2-inch-size) and [3 inch](/p/plast-o-matic-fc-series-constant-flow-control-valves-3-inch-size) listings.

faqs.q: What body, seal and connection does the Plast-O-Matic FC valve have?
faqs.a: PVC body, EPDM seal and NPT threaded connection, as the rows state. EPDM suits water and many dilute chemicals; check it against your fluid.

faqs.q: Which fluids suit the Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves?
faqs.a: Give us the fluid and temperature when you request a quotation. The PVC body and the seal listed on the rows of the Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves are chosen against it, and 5 part numbers are listed, such as FC200EP-050-PV, FC200EP-075-PV and FC200EP-100-PV.

faqs.q: Does Indus supply test documents with the Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves?
faqs.a: No certificate or approval is listed for the Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves. If your project needs a test report or certificate of conformity, state it on your [request](/contact) and we confirm what is available before supply.

faqs.q: What do I check before fitting the Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves?
faqs.a: Check the size, NPT thread or connection, seal and the pressure against the row you order. For the Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves the size table shows examples such as FC300EP-075-PV and FC300EP-100-PV.

faqs.q: How do I order the Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves?
faqs.a: Quote the Plast-O-Matic part number, such as FC200EP-050-PV, FC200EP-075-PV and FC200EP-100-PV, with the size and seal you need; 5 part numbers are listed. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: Where are the Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves used?
faqs.a: The Plast-O-Matic FC series constant flow control valves are used on chemical, water-treatment and process lines in PVC; see the [industrial process valves shelf](/c/industrial-process-valves) for related valves.

faqs.a: This listing has 5 part numbers from 1/2 to 1 inch, while the [2 inch listing](/p/plast-o-matic-fc-series-constant-flow-control-valves-2-inch-size) has 77 part numbers, all 2 inch, with the flow set by the part number.

faqs.q: What are Plast-O-Matic MFR series manual self-closing valves used for?

faqs.q: What sizes do the Plast-O-Matic MFR valves come in?
faqs.a: 1/2 inch and 3/4 inch, each with a Viton or an EPDM seal. That gives four part numbers. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: Viton or EPDM: which seal should I pick on an MFR valve?
faqs.a: Pick the seal against your fluid: Viton (FKM) suits oils and many chemicals, while EPDM suits water and many dilute acids and alkalis. State the fluid when you order.
